name: Delphox
description: Delphox, the Fox Pokémon, and the evolved form of Braixen. A Fire and Psychic type.
pokedex_entries: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.
Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.
